Two independent weekly ladders (A 146.72->257.10, B 337.90->407.50) frame it: the floor is the A-2.618/B-1.414 pair at 435.65/436.35 with the Apr-2026 low on it; the top is B-4.115 624.35 with the Mar/Aug-2026 highs. The middle is a dense pivot 546.00-558.13 (A-3.618, B-3.115, weekly SMA/EMA, daily slow EMA, monthly EMA). The 13-Nov drop shows price just back above that pivot after a higher low in October (454.50 vs 436.55); the 17-Nov tape is back under it. Range trade: buy the lower supports, sell 590-644; a daily close above 558.13 is needed before 589.75 is in play.
